This article describes a simple measurement and explains how to read the accompanying illustration. The measurement was repeated with several samples to check that the pattern remained consistent throughout the experiment. The first sample established a reference point, while the later samples tested whether changing one variable affected the recorded values. The authors describe these steps in ordinary prose so that the surrounding explanation remains useful without the illustration.
